CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.
   C. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.

2. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   C. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Songs.

3. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   B. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   D. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games.

4. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Guarantee a trophy

5. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   D. Damage equipment used for Athletics.

6. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   D. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. Best practice when working on Percussion Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Percussion Musical Instruments.
   B. Practise Percussion Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Percussion Musical Instruments.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Percussion Musical Instruments.

8. Best practice when working on Painting and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Painting and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Montage.
   C. Damage equipment used for Painting and Montage.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Montage.

9. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.

10. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Green, orange, and purple

11. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Netball.
   B. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Netball.
   D. Damage equipment used for Netball.

12. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the volume
   D. Only the costume

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Athletics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Gymnastics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
